item.title: Pokemon GO Leak Hints at Major Global Event
item.description:
A new Pokemon GO leak suggests a global event could bring some of its most recognizable Pokemon to multiple real-world landmarks. The potential event would build on a very familiar part of Pokemon GO , which has long used real places to give players something special to catch or collect.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

Pokemon GO recently wrapped up Pokemon GO Wild Area 2026, which began with in-person events in Sendai, Japan, and Mexico City, Mexico, from November 6 to 8. Both events gave players a great reason to explore the host cities as they caught and battled Pokemon throughout the weekend. A worldwide finale followed on November 14 and 15, opening the event to players who could take part from wherever they usually play. Fans who enjoyed this type of event may be happy to find that the latest datamine points to something similar happening soon, with a much wider range of locations than just two host cities.

Pokemon GO Players Can Claim 3 Free Codes Right Now

Pokemon GO trainers looking to pick up some freebies can do so with a trio of new codes that have been shared that can be redeemed right now.

By Sarah Fields

Pokemon GO Datamine Links 53 Pokemon to Real-World Landmarks

In a post on Twitter, The Pokemod Group shared a datamined list linking 53 Legendary Pokemon and Ultra Beasts to specific places around the world. One of the most notable is Mewtwo, which appears to be paired with Times Square in New York City, while Zapdos is paired with Hoover Dam on the Nevada-Arizona border, and Kyurem with the Antarctic Peninsula. Some of the pairings have a clear connection to the Pokemon involved, such as fire-type Entei at the Silvestri Craters on Sicily’s Mount Etna. Dialga, a Legendary associated with time, is paired with London’s Royal Observatory Greenwich, while the Ultra Beast Buzzwole gets Venice Beach in Los Angeles.

One possibility is that each landmark could host a raid featuring its assigned Pokemon, giving different regions different bosses to challenge during the same event. Pokemod floated that idea alongside special PokeStops and research tied to the listed locations. Additionally, the group spotted a reference called "WorldwidePokestop" in the game’s data, though that name alone offers little indication of how players would interact with the landmarks. The purpose of the pairings remains unclear, including whether they were designed for one global event or could be used separately over time.

Players have already seen one of these pairings in the game, and it made quite a stir. At the July 9 anniversary event in New York City, Pokemon GO fans could catch Mewtwo with a Times Square background, which would appear on the Pokemon’s summary screen to commemorate the event. The Pokemon GO team later said the Times Square background would return, giving another opportunity to collectors who missed the original event. The leaked landmark list could therefore be even more appealing to players who already have the Legendaries in their collection but still want something special in their inventories.

Kyurem’s appearance on the list also raises what could be the biggest practical question for a potential Pokemon GO raid event. It is more than likely that very few players could reasonably travel to the Antarctic Peninsula for an encounter, and even some of the more accessible landmarks would be out of reach for fans in other countries. Pokemon GO has previously adjusted its rules for remote participation, lifting the daily Remote Raid limit during GO Wild Area: Global, so if these landmark raids do happen, the option to join remotely could determine whether most players get a shot at the boss they want to catch.

item.title: LEGO Confirms New Video Game Sets That are Retiring Soon
item.description:
Three LEGO Animal Crossing sets are expected to leave the regular product cycle by December 31, 2026: 77053 Stargazing with Celeste, 77056 Blathers's Museum Collection, and 77058 Goldie's Cozy House. The Brick Fan reports that these three are on LEGO's retiring-soon list, and Nintendo Wire and other trackers place all three in the wave. The retirements come just after Nintendo and LEGO teased a new collaboration on November 17, and they sit within a wider phase-out of video game sets.

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover

Nintendo and LEGO have collaborated on sets for several of the video game company's iconic franchises. Aside from Animal Crossing , LEGO versions of Mario , The Legend of Zelda , and Pokemon have all hit store shelves for collectors to pick up. With the imminent retirement of these three Animal Crossing sets, fans won't have much longer to add LEGO sets based on Nintendo's cozy franchise to their collection.

Large-Scale LEGO Set for August 2027 Quietly Detailed in New Leak

A credible report offers a positive update on a large LEGO set for August 2027 that was previously rumored to have been delayed or even canceled.

By Dominik Bošnjak

LEGO Collectors Only Have Until December 31 to Pick Up Three Animal Crossing Sets

Set Number

Set Name

December 31, 2026

To make way for brand-new LEGO sets, the company is retiring some of its Animal Crossing sets that have been available since January 2025. Several LEGO Animal Crossing sets have already been retired, pulling fan-favorite sets like Isabelle's House Visit and Julian's Birthday Party from circulation. Time is officially running out for LEGO collectors to get their hands on these three retiring LEGO Animal Crossing sets, as several are already becoming hard to find.

The retirement of these three LEGO Animal Crossing sets marks the final time collectors will be able to add some unique minifigures to their collections. Stargazing with Celeste features the titular owl as a LEGO minifigure, while Blathers's Museum Collection includes both Blathers and Lily minifigures. Goldie's Cozy House, meanwhile, comes with a minifigure of the popular Animal Crossing villager Goldie.

Moreover, LEGO hasn't announced any new Animal Crossing sets for 2027, potentially sparking the end of the line for the theme after the final few sets retire in July of next year. The LEGO Sonic the Hedgehog sets also appear to be in the same boat as Animal Crossing , with no future sets announced after the current ones retire next year. However, a new line of Super Mario -themed LEGO sets featuring unique minifigures from the franchise is set to launch in January 2027, giving some solace to Nintendo fans disappointed about the retirement of these LEGO Animal Crossing sets.

There is still hope for the LEGO Animal Crossing line to see a resurgence in the future, as a new Animal Crossing game is rumored to be in development for the Nintendo Switch 2. Animal Crossing: New Horizons will be seven years old in 2027, and remains the Switch's second-best-selling game, just behind Mario Kart 8 Deluxe . As such, it seems like a new Animal Crossing game designed specifically for the Switch 2's hardware is just around the corner, and with it could come a completely new line of LEGO sets based on the game.

item.title: GTA 6: How to Use Phone
item.description:
Your smartphone is one of the most crucial tools in GTA 6 , serving as the central hub for everything from checking social media feeds to coordinating your next major heist. Since the game relies heavily on this digital interface to manage contacts, track your bank accounts, and navigate around Leonida, you'll need to get familiar with using the phone fast. Here's a quick guide taking you through how to pull up your phone, access the camera, text, and use social media in GTA 6 .

Add GameRant on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover
How to Auto-Drive in GTA 6

Enjoy the views of Vice City with the cinematic auto-drive mode in GTA 6.

By Greysun Morales

How to Pull Up Your Phone in GTA 6

Players can pull up their phone in GTA 6 by pressing the D-Pad Up button on the controller. Similar to GTA 5 , pulling up your phone won't pause the game, so it's important that you don't do it during a hostile encounter or while driving.

Players will be able to first pull up their phone during the prologue, as soon as they take control of Jason on the boat.

There are several features on the phone, and more will be added as you progress through the story, like the BuckMe banking app. Here's a quick breakdown of some of the applications you can use on the phone in GTA 6 .

Phone App

What Does It Do?

WhatUp

Messaging application. You can send and recieve messages to your contacts with it.

RydeMe

Spoof of Uber/Lyft, a ride-hailing app that you can use to fast travel across the map. Will cost money though.

Contacts

Place calls to your contacts with this.

Camera

Take photos and selfies with both rear and front cameras, respectively.

BuckMe

A spoof of Venmo that you can use to send and recieve money, including making purchases.

Fitness

Track your physical stats with personalized goals to keep fitness on track.

Gallery

View your snapped photos from your smartphone camera.

Snapmatic

Spoof of Snapchat, a social media application that lets you view both videos and images online.

News

An online news app that brings you the latest from Leonida.

Weather

Latest information on weather and forecasts.

WAiNK

A scanner application that gets you all the details about a targeted vehicle.

Depending on your replies to Lucia or lack thereof, you can raise or decrease your relationship status with her in GTA 6 .

How to Change Wallpaper and Ringtone on GTA 6 Phone

If you want to personalize the smartphone in GTA 6 , you can change its display wallpaper and the ringtone. Simply pull up your smartphone and head into settings to do both.

  • Ringtone : You can select from 11 ringtones that also change the vibration pattern of your controller when you recieve a call. PlayStation 5 players will also hear the ringtone through the DualSense controller's speaker.
  • Wallpaper : You can select and personalize the look of your phone from 25 wallpapers.

item.title: All Upcoming Fortnite Treasure Hour Start Times (2x Pirate Shop Token Chance)
item.description:
Fortnite Treasure Hunters offers players a selection of free weekly rewards to earn throughout the remainder of the season, ranging from the Pirate Shop Access Token to various Golden Cars and Skins. While some of these rewards are incredibly rare, the Pirate Shop Token and other Treasure drop rates are boosted during Treasure Hours. Here's when to expect all Treasure Hours in Fortnite Treasure Hunters.

All Fortnite Treasure Hours & Their Start Times

The next Fortnite Treasure Hours begin this Saturday, November 21, from 2 PM to 4 PM ET and 9 PM to 11 PM ET. During these periods, Sprite and Treasure reward drop rates will be boosted. Here’s a rundown of all the upcoming Treasure Hours for the mini-season:

What is the Pirate Token Drop Rate During Fortnite's Treasure Hours?

The Pirate Shop Access Token has its drop rate doubled during all Saturday Treasure Hours. This increases your chances of finding one to 1 in 68,750 Chests , equivalent to a 0.00145% drop rate during each session. However, the Token isn't the only reward to receive a boost, as all other Treasure rewards, including the Weekly Gold Skin, also have increased drop rates.

Here's a breakdown of the drop rate multipliers for each Treasure reward during Treasure Hours:

  • Pirate Shop Access Token: 2x
  • Weekly Gold Outfit: 7.5x
  • Weekly Vehicle and Decal: 10x

What Rewards Are Available During Fortnite's Treasure Hours?

Although each Treasure reward is available throughout the week leading up to Treasure Hours, these sessions provide a final opportunity to obtain that week's rewards before they are replaced by the next set. They also offer boosted drop rates, making them the best time to get the Weekly Gold Skin and even the Pirate Shop Token.

item.title: WoW Forever: The Sacred Flame Quest Guide
item.description:
There are quite a lot of confusing quests in WoW Forever , especially those where the objective is not marked on the map or the different parts of the quest are too far apart. The Sacred Flame quest starts in Thunder Bluff after you talk to Zangen Stonehoof, who wants you to get a Phial and then fill it. This guide covers the location of the Phial, as well as a walkthrough for the rest of this small quest.

Wow Forever: Where to Find the Paladin Trainer in Orgrimmar

Looking to learn new Paladin skills? Here's where you can find the trainer for Paladins in WoW Forever.

By Waseem Muhammad

Where to Find the Phial for The Sacred Flame Quest in WoW Forever

Once you have acquired the quest, you will be tasked with visiting Ashenvale, which is where the objective related to the Filled Etched Phial is. However, since you don't have the Phial yet, you will need to find it first. Do not worry, as its location is very close to the marked objective. You need to make your way west of Raynewood Retreat. This area is filled with Laughing Sister enemies, which you need to deal with. The drop rate for the Phial is around 20%, so you will need to defeat a few of these enemies before the item eventually drops.

Since you only need one item, you can invite any player whom you see around the area doing the same quest to your party, allowing you to deal with multiple enemies at the same time and speed up the process. You can also invite one of your friends or guild members to help you out, but make sure they are on the same phase; otherwise, you won't be able to see them.

Once you have the item, make your way to the area marked on the map south of here. You will find a small pool where you need to use the Etched Phial to fill it, completing the objective. Once you have it, make your way back to Zangen in Thunder Bluff, and you will get 30 Silver and over 2,500 experience for completing this quest. You will also get another quest by the same name, but this one takes place in Thousand Needles.
